cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PY'
p='crosscheck/replay.py'
s=open(p).read()
anchor='''class CrossCheck:
    """Replay one stream's topology, settings and events."""
'''
insert='''def _clone_frozen(frozen: FrozenRepair) -> FrozenRepair:
    """Make a structurally independent immutable snapshot.

    The payload consists only of integers, strings and tuples, but rebuilding
    the outer and inner tuples makes cache entries and snapshots independent
    even under code that might later replace a FrozenRepair field wholesale.
    """
    return FrozenRepair(
        tuple(tuple(item) for item in frozen.links),
        tuple(tuple(item) for item in frozen.order),
        tuple(tuple(item) for item in frozen.counters),
    )


class CrossCheck:
    """Replay one stream's topology, settings and events."""
'''
assert anchor in s
s=s.replace(anchor,insert)
s=s.replace('''                self.cache.move_to_end(key)
                self.snapshots[request_id] = cached
                return self._publication(cached, request_id, True)
''','''                self.cache.move_to_end(key)
                self.snapshots[request_id] = _clone_frozen(cached)
                return self._publication(cached, request_id, True)
''')
s=s.replace('''        # Snapshots are independent of later cache eviction.  FrozenRepair is
        # immutable, so sharing its tuple payload cannot alias mutable state.
        self.snapshots[request_id] = frozen
        return self._publication(frozen, request_id, False)
''','''        # Snapshots are independent of later cache eviction and of the cache
        # entry itself.
        self.snapshots[request_id] = _clone_frozen(frozen)
        return self._publication(frozen, request_id, False)
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
